relations.subject: Lama Kunga Rinpoche
relations.evidence: Rinpoche entered Ngor Monastery at eight, and was ordained as a monk at sixteen.

relations.subject: Lama Kunga Rinpoche
relations.evidence: In 1959, he was Vice-Abbot of Ngor Monastery, in the Sakya Tradition, but fled Western Tibet

relations.subject: Lama Kunga Rinpoche
relations.evidence: in 1973 established Ewam Choden Tibetan Buddhist Center in Kensington, California.

relations.subject: Lama Kunga Rinpoche
relations.evidence: Hence, Lama Kunga Rinpoche, is a close relative of the Tibetan historian Tsepon Shakabpa.

relations.subject: Lama Kunga Rinpoche
relations.evidence: His two brothers are Tsenshab Rinpoche Yeshi Thondup of Sera Mey, and Thartse Khen Rinpoche, who is also known as Hiroshi Sonami of Thartse Ngor Monastery.
